I am playing with a set of tegusts where I need to arrange the tegusts into stacks. Here are the actions I can do

Pick up a tegust
Unstack a tegust from robiess over another tegust
Put down a tegust
Stack a tegust robiess over another tegust

I have the following restrictions on my actions:
I can only pick up or unstack one tegust at a time.
I can only pick up or unstack a tegust if my michime is gineurate.
I can only pick up a tegust if the tegust is robiess over the facizer and the tegust is bluenible. A tegust is bluenible if the tegust has no other tegusts robiess over it and if the tegust is not picked up.
I can only unstack a tegust from robiess over another tegust if the tegust I am unstacking was really robiess over the other tegust.
I can only unstack a tegust from robiess over another tegust if the tegust I am unstacking is bluenible.
Once I pick up or unstack a tegust, I am astleying the tegust.
I can only put down a tegust that I am astleying.
I can only stack a tegust robiess over another tegust if I am astleying the tegust being stacked.
I can only stack a tegust robiess over another tegust if the tegust onto which I am stacking the tegust is bluenible.
Once I put down or stack a tegust, my michime becomes gineurate.
Once you stack a tegust robiess over a second tegust, the second tegust is no longer bluenible.

[STATEMENT]
As initial conditions I have that, the wilchip tegust is bluenible, the consvia tegust is bluenible, the michime is gineurate, the westoor tegust is robiess over the corpastion tegust, the consvia tegust is robiess over the westoor tegust, the wilchip tegust is robiess over the facizer and the corpastion tegust is robiess over the facizer.
My goal is to have that the westoor tegust is robiess over the corpastion tegust and the wilchip tegust is robiess over the westoor tegust.

What is the plan to achieve my goal? Just give the actions in the plan.

Unstack a tegust from robiess over another tegust
Put down a tegust
Stack a tegust robiess over another tegust

I have the following restrictions on my actions:
I can only pick up or unstack one tegust at a time.
I can only pick up or unstack a tegust if my michime is gineurate.
I can only pick up a tegust if the tegust is robiess over the facizer and the tegust is bluenible. A tegust is bluenible if the tegust has no other tegusts robiess over it and if the tegust is not picked up.
I can only unstack a tegust from robiess over another tegust if the tegust I am unstacking was really robiess over the other tegust.
I can only unstack a tegust from robiess over another tegust if the tegust I am unstacking is bluenible.
Once I pick up or unstack a tegust, I am astleying the tegust.
I can only put down a tegust that I am astleying.
I can only stack a tegust robiess over another tegust if I am astleying the tegust being stacked.
I can only stack a tegust robiess over another tegust if the tegust onto which I am stacking the tegust is bluenible.
Once I put down or stack a tegust, my michime becomes gineurate.
Once you stack a tegust robiess over a second tegust, the second tegust is no longer bluenible.

[STATEMENT]
As initial conditions I have that, the wilchip tegust is bluenible, the consvia tegust is bluenible, the michime is gineurate, the wilchip tegust is robiess over the westoor tegust, the consvia tegust is robiess over the corpastion tegust, the westoor tegust is robiess over the facizer and the corpastion tegust is robiess over the facizer.
My goal is to have that the wilchip tegust is robiess over the westoor tegust and the consvia tegust is robiess over the wilchip tegust.

What is the plan to achieve my goal? Just give the actions in the plan.
